pack-land: A digital package arriving: a short low electronic thud with a clean sub-bass hit and a brief synth blip, UI sound.
pack-hover: A tiny clean electronic blip, a high pitched UI hover sound, very short.
tear-scrub: Continuous digital glitch static scrubbing, a granular noise zipper, electronic tearing texture, steady and loopable.
tear: A fast electronic zipper-rip sweep with digital glitch crackle ending on a sharp click.
pack-burst: An electronic burst: a rising synth sweep into a clean digital impact with bright bleeps, sci-fi unlock sound.
cards-slide: A quick digital swoosh, a clean synthetic slide sweep with tiny ticks, UI transition.
deal: A short crisp digital whip, a clean UI swipe sound, very short.
flip: A sharp digital click-flip, a clean short UI toggle with a tiny pitch blip, very short.
uncommon: A single clean soft synth ping, bright and short.
rare: A rising two-note synth arpeggio with a clean shimmering pluck, achievement unlocked, short.
mythic: A big sci-fi reward sting: a deep sub drop, a rising synth riser, then a bright stacked arpeggio chord with glitter, epic achievement unlock.
select: A crisp clean UI select click with a small bright blip and a short decay, clearly audible.
deselect: A lower muted UI click with a short soft blip, a cancel tick, clearly audible.
pick: A confirm sound: a clean synth bleep-bleep rising, short and satisfying UI confirm.
burn: A digital disintegration: a bit-crushed zap and a descending glitch noise burst.
pack-arrive: A quick incoming data whoosh with a soft landing click, UI notification.
pack-pass: A quick outgoing swish with a fading blip, UI send sound.
tick: A single loud clear electronic countdown beep: a short bright square-wave blip with a quick decay, like a metronome click. Dry, no music.
tap: A dull clear UI tap, a short low thud-click with a quick decay, clearly audible.
zoom-open: A smooth rising UI expand sweep with a soft blip, a panel opening.
zoom-close: A smooth falling UI collapse sweep with a soft blip, a panel closing.
row-hover: An extremely short quiet electronic tick, a barely audible UI hover.
turn-over: A quick UI toggle flip: a short swish and two tiny clicks.
